Description: A single fragment from Qumran Cave 4, catalogued as 4Q26b, preserving Leviticus 7:19-26; it contains the divine name written in paleo-Hebrew script within a square-script text. (No separate 4QLevf is catalogued; the lettering jumps from e to g.)
Significance: A tiny but notable fragment: the paleo-Hebrew divine name inside a square-script Leviticus copy.
